name: Late delivery
description: Order arrived much later than promised, or the delivery time kept increasing.

name: Delivery partner behaviour
description: Rider was rude, asked for extra money, refused to come to the door, or marked the order delivered without delivering it.

name: Wrong or missing items
description: Received the wrong dish, or some items in the order were missing.

name: Food quality & hygiene
description: Food was cold, stale, spoiled, tasted bad, had small portions, or packaging leaked.

name: Pricing & fees
description: High delivery, platform, packaging or surge fees, or menu prices higher than at the restaurant.

name: Payment problems
description: Money deducted but order failed, charged twice, or charged an amount the user did not expect.

name: Refund issues
description: Refund delayed, denied, partial, or given only as app wallet credit.

name: Order cancellation issues
description: User could not cancel, was charged a cancellation fee, or the order was cancelled by the restaurant or app.

name: Customer support
description: Only a chatbot, could not reach a human agent, complaint not resolved, or support was rude.

name: App bugs & usability
description: App crashes, errors, slow loading, login or OTP problems, or wrong address or location.

name: Offers, coupons & memberships
description: Coupons not applying, misleading discounts, or memberships like Swiggy One or Zomato Gold not giving promised benefits.

name: Praise: fast & convenient
description: Positive review about quick delivery or easy ordering.

name: Praise: food & service quality
description: Positive review about tasty food, good packaging or helpful service.

name: Praise: general
description: General positive review without a specific reason.

name: Complaint: general
description: Negative review with no specific reason, like 'worst app' or 'very bad service'.

name: Other
description: Unrelated to the app experience, or impossible to judge (e.g. 'don't know yet').
